description.value: Antidote Distilling Company is a craft distillery in Port Alberni, Vancouver Island, producing award-winning artisanal spirits — including a Black Gin that earned Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition — made with locally sourced grains and wild-foraged ingredients. They operate an on-site restaurant serving cocktails and food, and offer a 'Gin Academy' experience where visitors distill and bottle their own personalized gin. With a sustainability focus on recycled glass bottles and a low carbon footprint, they describe themselves as a postcard for the Alberni Valley.
